summary: The user lost almost 600 dollars through a service called Tradyon snipe bot after repeatedly paying additional amounts to withdraw purported funds. The user later resumed crypto trading with 35 dollars and separately lost those funds through three rug pulls.
user_mistake: sent repeated payments to release funds from an unverified trading service
prevention: Stop sending additional funds when a trading service requires payments to release existing funds / Confirm withdrawals before depositing additional money
classification_warning: mixed scam patterns with separate rug pull losses
